description: Source code implementation of QuicCoalescedPacket class handling packet coalescing in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicCoalescedPacket
classes.description: Handles coalescing multiple QUIC packets into a single packet for efficient transmission.

methods.name: MaybeCoalescePacket
methods.description: Attempts to coalesce a packet with the current coalesced packet if conditions permit.

methods.name: NeuterInitialPacket
methods.description: Removes the initial packet from the coalesced packet, updating length accordingly.

methods.name: CopyEncryptedBuffers
methods.description: Copies encrypted buffers into a provided buffer.

methods.name: ContainsPacketOfEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Checks if the coalesced packet contains a packet of a specific encryption level.

methods.name: TransmissionTypeOfPacket
methods.description: Returns the transmission type of a packet at a specific encryption level.

methods.name: NumberOfPackets
methods.description: Returns the total number of packets contained in the coalesced packet.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the coalesced packet details.

methods.name: packet_lengths
methods.description: Returns a vector of lengths of individual packets within the coalesced packet.
